dataList.name: I can cook up delicious dishes so good, you hear?
dataList.desc: If this unit has [SapsareeCooking], use the "Aah! I'm on lunch break, you hear?" Skill at the very end of the turn (does not activate if all other targets are defeated, or if this unit is Staggered) Turn End: If this unit failed to use the "Aah! I'm on lunch break, you hear?" Skill, gain 1 [SapsareeHungry]
dataList.flavor: The restaurant on 5F would not dignify this with the word "cooking."

dataList.name: Handmade
dataList.desc: Skill Final Power +1 for every Needlekin on the field
dataList.flavor: No hand sewing survives on one pair of hands alone. A host of practiced artisans are needed to breathe life into it.

dataList.name: Le Noir: Gabardine Fabric
dataList.desc:
Encounter Start: Gain 30 [NoirSuit]

Turn Start: Gain Shield equal to ([NoirSuit] / 5)% of this unit's max HP (unless Staggered)
dataList.flavor: The Noirs' flagship gabardine, tailored toward formality without sacrificing firmness.

dataList.name: Formation Conservation
dataList.desc:
Boost the level of "Le Noir" allies

All "Le Noir" allies take -5% damage for every living "Le Noir" ally on the field
On death of a "Le Noir" ally, all "Le Noir" allies gain 1 [NoirSquareCollapse] for the rest of this Encounter (including newly summoned units)
dataList.flavor: Each stays at their post and faithfully performs the duty entrusted to them. Together, they form a formation, and that formation becomes an image that preserves the whole. Fulfill thy charge faithfully, each in thine appointed place.
